title: Real In, Real Out! Functions Explained Simply | PUC Maths Class 11
description:
Your body temperature is lowest around 4 a.m. and highest in the late afternoon, and every hour gives exactly one reading. One hour in, one real number out: what kind of function is that? In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Maths (NCERT Chapter 2, Relations and Functions) we meet real valued functions and real functions.

You will watch Diya's temperature graph draw itself live as the hour counts up, compare a real function with one that is only real valued, convert Celsius to Fahrenheit with t(C) = 9C/5 + 32, and scan the number line to find the domain of 1/(x - 2) and the square root of x - 1. Two pause-and-think questions, a worked example with a fraction, the exam trap of cancelling before finding the domain, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11 and JEE Main students.

In this video:
0:00 Body temperature: one number every hour
0:29 Real valued function vs real function

1:15 Real function or only real valued? Side by side
1:57 Celsius to Fahrenheit: t(C) = 9C/5 + 32
2:41 Finding the domain from the rule
3:29 Worked example: a domain with a fraction
4:09 Exam trap: never cancel first
4:31 Where it is asked
4:43 Practice question (JEE Main pattern)
5:18 Recap and three questions to answer

Next episode (Ep 19): Constant, Identity and Polynomial Functions. A fixed bus fare, a mirror and a square plot: three rules, three famous graphs.
